## [1.6.2](https://github.com/southstar21dev/southstar21-patches/compare/v1.6.1...v1.6.2) (2026-11-04)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* Stop the navigation bar selection pill jumping when tapping quickly between tabs ([bdebdf6](https://github.com/southstar21dev/southstar21-patches/commit/bdebdf67329f4c063a07c73c2505dbe2e95fad83))

patches.name: Bypass signature check
patches.description: Stops Instagram rejecting apps by their signature, which a patched app no longer matches.

patches.name: Disable Reels
patches.description: Removes reels from the home feed and Explore, and stops scrolling from one reel to the next. Each part can be switched off in the settings.

patches.name: Hide navigation buttons
patches.description: Adds settings to hide Search, Reels, Create, Messages and other tabs from the bottom bar.

patches.name: Liquid Glass navigation bar
patches.description: Turns the bottom tab bar into a floating iOS 26 style Liquid Glass pill with live background blur and edge refraction. Refraction needs Android 13+, blur needs Android 12+, older versions get a tinted pill.

options.description: Blur applied to content behind the bar, in dp.
How strongly the glass edge bends the content behind it, from 0 to 100.
Lets feeds scroll underneath the bar so there is something to see through the glass. Turn off if the last item of a list ends up hidden.

patches.name: Remove build expired popup
patches.description: Removes the popup that appears after a while, when the app version ages.
